acceptanceCriteria: A proposed spec (human acceptance required) defines the obligation model, states, evidence, Playwright step crediting and no-progress fingerprint change, with non-goals, failure modes and rollback.
After acceptance: implementation with focused tests, a real Playwright report qualification and sealed change evidence; GitHub #680 closed by the merged PR.
body: GitHub beamfall/corvint#680. Track acceptance obligations (e.g. test-matrix rows) natively per ticket: ticket obligations seed|show|witness|set with states open|witnessed|defect|blocked|deferred, a core flag and evidence (manifest, test id, step title, commit); witness --from-playwright-report crediting by id in test or step titles using each step's own error state; workState and the no-progress fingerprint use the witnessed count; queue status shows witnessed/total; optional plan check that each open obligation maps to exactly one planned test.
title: corvint-tasks: native per-ticket obligation ledger with step-level Playwright witnessing (GitHub #680)
